title: Multimodal Support in Gen AI Studio Playground
assumptions: The local RFE snapshot has proposed acceptance criteria but no explicit user story section; stories were derived from its scope and criteria.
The prototype uses one Playground route. AI Asset registration is represented as a contextual side panel because the request targets a standalone prototype.
Model and ASR endpoints are representative mock data; the prototype demonstrates UI flows and does not make inference or upload requests to a backend.
The RFE describes 10 MB as a proposed default matching the existing upload baseline; the prototype uses 10 MB as the visible mock limit.
